isekai_ui.inventory.title: Inventory
isekai_ui.map.title: Map
isekai_ui.commands.empty: No commands learned yet. Use a server command (e.g. /pets); if it opens a menu, it shows up here.
isekai_ui.map.emblem_hint: Put cut-out PNGs (flags, crests) in the icons folder and reload.
isekai_ui.button.go_craft: Craft (closes the chest and opens your inventory; then come back)
isekai_ui.chatwp.hover:
Save "%s" as a waypoint
X %s  Y %s  Z %s
Format: %s
isekai_ui.commands.add_tip: Type a command to always have it at hand
isekai_ui.creative.personal_tip: Click: take a copy • Right-click: take it out • Shift: copy straight to the inventory
isekai_ui.creative.personal_empty_tip: Click while holding an item to keep it here
isekai_ui.creative.title: Creative
isekai_ui.creative.trash: Trash: click with an item in hand to delete it • Shift + click twice: clear the bag and hotbar
isekai_ui.territory.title: Territories
isekai_ui.territory.hint: Click or drag on the map to paint chunks for the chosen kingdom. Right-click erases. Shift+drag moves the map.
isekai_ui.territory.row_tip: Click: paint with this kingdom • Right-click: rename
isekai_ui.armor.hint_creative: Click a set to wear it
isekai_ui.armor.hint_survival: Click: wear it using pieces from your bag
isekai_ui.armor.missing: %s pieces were not in your bag
isekai_ui.armor.delete_confirm: Click the X again to delete
isekai_ui.armor.row_tip_survival: Click: wear using the pieces in your bag • Right-click: rename
isekai_ui.creative.mode.personal_tip: Your item copies, saved on your computer and sorted into tabs
isekai_ui.personal.tab_tip_store: Click: store the held item in this tab
isekai_ui.personal.icon_hint: Icon: click it holding an item
isekai_ui.personal.delete_confirm: Click again to delete the tab
isekai_ui.personal.delete_confirm_items: Click again: deletes the tab and its %s items
isekai_ui.personal.editor.icon: Tab icon: click holding an item to use it • Empty hand: automatic icon
isekai_ui.personal.empty_tab: Empty tab: click here holding an item
isekai_ui.personal.empty_all: Empty chest: Shift+click an item in your bag to save a copy
isekai_ui.creative.trash_hint: Pick up an item to delete it, or Shift + click to clear the bag
isekai_ui.creative.clear_confirm: Shift + click again to clear the bag and hotbar
isekai_ui.creative.already_empty: The bag and hotbar are already empty
isekai_ui.hud_editor.title: On-screen minimap
isekai_ui.hud_editor.hint1: Drag the minimap anywhere you like
isekai_ui.hud_editor.hint3: Right click: back to the corner
isekai_ui.recipes.empty: No recipes written down here yet. Make an item at this station and it shows up in the grimoire.
isekai_ui.recipes.count_untested: Written down: %s • From the server, untested: %s
isekai_ui.recipes.place_tip: Puts the ingredients from your bag into the station (Shift: as many as possible)
isekai_ui.recipes.test_tip: Asks the server to place the ingredients: if the result shows up, the recipe is written down
isekai_ui.recipes.untested_tip: Not tested yet: the server lists this recipe, but it may not work
isekai_ui.recipes.untested_toggle_tip: They show up with "?". When tested, working ones are written down and fake ones disappear.
isekai_ui.recipes.cannot_test: This recipe can't be tested here
isekai_ui.recipes.busy: Hold on, still placing the items...
isekai_ui.recipes.hand_full: Put down the item in your hand first
isekai_ui.recipes.fake: That server recipe doesn't work: removed from the grimoire
isekai_ui.recipes.test_missing: The server didn't place the items (missing something in the bag?)
isekai_ui.settings.title: Isekai UI settings
isekai_ui.settings.done_reset_layouts: Windows are back in their default places
isekai_ui.settings.done_bar_reset: The bar is back to default
isekai_ui.settings.done_forget_fakes: Fake recipes forgotten: they can be tested again
isekai_ui.settings.bar_hint: Eye: show or hide • Arrows: change the order. When there are more buttons than the limit, the last ones go into the "..." button.
isekai_ui.settings.bar_item_tip: Eye: show/hide this button • Arrows: move it left or right on the bar
isekai_ui.settings.bar_item_locked: The gear never hides and never goes into "..." (it's how you get here)
isekai_ui.settings.recipes_hint: The grimoire only writes down recipes that really worked: the result has to show up at the crafting table or station.
isekai_ui.settings.recipes_count: On this server — recipes written down: %s • fake recipes hidden: %s
isekai_ui.settings.opt.inventory.tip: Replaces the inventory (E key) with the isekai-style status window.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.containers.tip: Chests, barrels, shulkers and similar in isekai style. Plugin menus (with another title) never change.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.stations.tip: Crafting table, furnaces, anvil, smithing, grindstone, stonecutter, brewing stand and enchanting in isekai style.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.creative.tip: Creative inventory with catalog, personal chest, minimap and armor sets.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.shulker_preview.t: Shows the items inside a shulker box when you hover over it.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.animations.tip: Windows slide in and out. Off: everything opens instantly.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.third_person.tip: When the inventory opens the camera shows your character (F5 inside the inventory toggles it).
isekai_ui.settings.opt.pose.tip: Your character raises their arms as if touching the status window.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.hide_held.tip: Hides the item in your character's hand while the inventory is open.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.reset_layouts.tip: Forgets where you dragged each window (inventory, chests, stations and creative).
isekai_ui.settings.opt.ui_sounds.tip: Sounds for opening windows, clicks and hovering buttons.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.volume_all.tip: Volume of every Isekai UI sound.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.volume_windows.ti: Sound when the inventory, chests and map open/close. Lower it if opening and closing a lot gets tiring.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.volume_clicks.tip: Sound when clicking and hovering buttons.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.require_clock.tip: Without a clock in the bag the minimap only shows sun/moon; with one it shows the time.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.require_compass.t: Without a compass in the bag, coordinates and the on-screen minimap stay hidden.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.horizon.tip: While holding the compass, markers show at the top of the screen in the right direction.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.hud_minimap.tip: Shows a minimap on screen while you have a compass.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.hud_size.tip: Size of the minimap shown while playing.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.hud_corner.tip: One of the screen corners, or "Custom" to drag it anywhere.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.hud_move.tip: Opens a screen to drag the minimap and resize it with the mouse wheel.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.minimap_zoom.tip: How close the minimap (inventory and on-screen) zooms in.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.show_entities.tip: Dots for nearby animals and monsters on the map (players never show).
isekai_ui.settings.opt.show_claims.tip: Paints each kingdom/claim's chunks on the map.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.show_grid.tip: Chunk lines on the big map.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.show_waypoints.ti: Your markers on the map and minimap.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.chat_waypoints.ti: Chat messages with markers from other map mods get a button to save the marker.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.share_format.tip: How a marker is written in chat when shared, for people using another map mod.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.lands_auto.tip: Reads the titles Lands shows when entering a claim. Off: territories are painted by hand on the map.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.bar_max.tip: How many buttons fit on the bar; the rest are kept inside the "..." button.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.bar_reset.tip: Shows every button again, in the original order, with a limit of 8.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.show_untested.tip: Shows (with "?") the recipes the server sends, so you can test them. Working ones get written down.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.notify_learned.ti: Shows a small notice at the top of the screen when a new recipe is written down.
isekai_ui.settings.opt.forget_fakes.tip: Server recipes that failed the test show up again (with "?") to be tested again.
